title: M5: Export from the app, every example exporting, and owner acceptance
description:
## Purpose

Export from where people make scores, and close the initiative: the local server (`apricity serve`) hands the web app a zipped DAW set for a saved score, every example exports cleanly, and the owner accepts the result in the DAW.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant W as web app (Score view)
  participant S as apricity serve
  participant L as library
  W->>S: GET /export/daw-set/{scoreId} (x-api-key)
  S->>L: score text + samples
  S-->>W: 200 application/zip "Name Project/…" or 422 with located errors
```

## Scope

A route in `crates/apricity-cli/src/serve.rs`; a need filed for the web session (label `web`); an examples smoke script; final docs; acceptance.

## Out of scope

Export from the cloud deployment (no local server there; see open question on the initiative). Python `server.py`: its data endpoints are being retired (apricitus-8cecf2), so no Python parity.

## Definition of Done

1. Specs: `features/serve/serve.feature` gains the export scenarios (Rust tests in serve.rs, as the file says); all green.
2. Rust only. 3. Schema: not applicable (the error body reuses the CLI's messages).
4. CLI: none new; the route shares `export.rs` with the command.
5. Fixtures: a library fixture as in serve.rs tests; no audio in git.
6. Design: `design/storage.md` §4 lists the route; `design/daw-set.md` final status.
7. Docs: `docs/tools.md` (the route, the app's export), README status line.
8. Web: one `web` task describing the need, no visuals.
9. Verification: `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-cli serve`; `scripts/daw-export-smoke.sh`; manual acceptance of every example in the DAW.
10. Running log. 11. `feat(<task id>)`; not breaking.
12. Route and smoke depend on M1; acceptance depends on M1–M4.
